zion-narrows-conditions.title: Zion Narrows Conditions Today | Chris Izworski
zion-narrows-conditions.description: See current Virgin River flow, water temperature, flash-flood warnings, and NPS flow thresholds before deciding whether to hike the Zion Narrows.
zion-narrows-conditions.h1: Can I hike the Zion Narrows today?
zion-narrows-conditions.lede: One decision card combines the live Virgin River gauge, flash-flood warning status, water temperature and the NPS flow rules that actually change the trip.
zion-narrows-conditions.decisionTitle: What this tool is trying to answer
zion-narrows-conditions.decisionBody: The Narrows is a conditions problem, not a generic hiking forecast. River flow changes difficulty, NPS uses specific flow thresholds for closures and permits, and flash-flood warnings can override an otherwise modest gauge reading. This tool puts those pieces in one place.
bullets: Bottom-up Narrows access closes when flow is above 150 cfs.
Top-down Narrows access above Big Spring closes when flow is above 120 cfs.
An active Flash Flood Warning closes The Narrows; NPS keeps it closed for at least two hours after the warning is lifted.
zion-narrows-conditions.sourceTitle: See the evidence behind the answer
zion-narrows-conditions.sourceBody: USGS station 09405500 supplies live North Fork Virgin River flow and water temperature. NWS active alerts are checked for the park point. NPS rules remain authoritative.

old-faithful-next-eruption.title: Old Faithful Next Eruption Live | Chris Izworski
old-faithful-next-eruption.description: Check the next Old Faithful eruption prediction, expected window, source freshness, and official Yellowstone geyser guidance before you walk over.
old-faithful-next-eruption.h1: When is Old Faithful expected to erupt next?
old-faithful-next-eruption.lede: A clean next-eruption check for Yellowstone visitors: prediction first, source freshness second, official park guidance one tap away.
old-faithful-next-eruption.decisionTitle: What this tool is trying to answer
old-faithful-next-eruption.decisionBody: Old Faithful is predictable, but not on a fixed clock. The useful question is not how often it erupts. It is what the current prediction says, how fresh it is, and how long you should plan to wait.
bullets: Treat the prediction as a window, not an appointment.
Arrive early enough to find a viewing spot before the predicted window.
If the live feed is unavailable, this page deliberately stops instead of estimating from an average interval.
old-faithful-next-eruption.sourceTitle: See the evidence behind the answer
old-faithful-next-eruption.sourceBody: The live card uses the GeyserTimes prediction feed and points back to NPS Yellowstone for official park guidance. Geysers are natural features; predictions are estimates, not schedules.

going-to-the-sun-road-status.title: Going-to-the-Sun Road Status | Chris Izworski
going-to-the-sun-road-status.description: Check the current Going-to-the-Sun Road status before crossing Glacier: through-travel signal, official source excerpt, and direct NPS status link.
going-to-the-sun-road-status.h1: Is Going-to-the-Sun Road open right now?
going-to-the-sun-road-status.lede: A through-drive decision first: current NPS status, the source language behind it, and no guessed opening date when mountain weather changes the answer.
going-to-the-sun-road-status.decisionTitle: What this tool is trying to answer
going-to-the-sun-road-status.decisionBody: Going-to-the-Sun Road has a huge difference between some lower sections being open and actually being able to drive across the park. This tool is designed around that distinction and reports only what the current NPS source supports.
bullets: Look specifically for through travel, not merely an open entrance segment.
Road status can change quickly for weather, construction or seasonal closure.
Vehicle restrictions and reservation rules are separate from the road being physically open.
going-to-the-sun-road-status.sourceTitle: See the evidence behind the answer
going-to-the-sun-road-status.sourceBody: The live card checks the NPS Glacier road-status surface and classifies explicit current open/closed language. Ambiguous mixed text returns VERIFY rather than an invented answer.

yellowstone-road-status.title: Yellowstone Road Status Today | Chris Izworski
yellowstone-road-status.description: Check Yellowstone road status before choosing an entrance or cross-park route. Current NPS road language is surfaced with a direct official-source link.
yellowstone-road-status.h1: Which Yellowstone roads are usable today?
yellowstone-road-status.lede: Yellowstone route planning starts with roads, not attractions. Check the current NPS road-status language before committing to an entrance or long cross-park drive.
yellowstone-road-status.decisionTitle: What this tool is trying to answer
yellowstone-road-status.decisionBody: Yellowstone is too large for a generic park-open answer. Seasonal gates, temporary closures and entrance-to-entrance routing determine whether a plan works. The live card surfaces the current NPS road page and refuses to turn ambiguous source text into a false all-clear.
bullets: Confirm the road system before choosing your entrance.
Do not assume a mapping app knows about a temporary park closure.
Winter and shoulder-season travel can use a very different road network than summer.
yellowstone-road-status.sourceTitle: See the evidence behind the answer
yellowstone-road-status.sourceBody: The tool checks the current NPS Yellowstone road page for explicit current-status language and shows the supporting source excerpt.

trail-ridge-road-status.title: Trail Ridge Road Status Today | Chris Izworski
trail-ridge-road-status.description: See whether Trail Ridge Road is open to through travel using the current Rocky Mountain National Park status page and a direct NPS source check.
trail-ridge-road-status.h1: Is Trail Ridge Road open to through travel?
trail-ridge-road-status.lede: The useful answer is through travel across Rocky Mountain National Park—not whether a lower mile of pavement happens to be open.
trail-ridge-road-status.decisionTitle: What this tool is trying to answer
trail-ridge-road-status.decisionBody: Trail Ridge Road can close or reopen with fast mountain-weather changes. This page is intentionally narrow: it checks for explicit NPS through-travel status and puts the source text beside the result so a visitor can verify the decision before driving.
bullets: Open to through travel is the key phrase for a cross-park drive.
Weather can change road status rapidly even during the normal open season.
Timed-entry requirements and road status are separate decisions.
trail-ridge-road-status.sourceTitle: See the evidence behind the answer
trail-ridge-road-status.sourceBody: The live card checks the current NPS road-status page and classifies only explicit open/closed language. Mixed or unclear language returns VERIFY.
trail-ridge-road-status.sourceLinkLabel: Open NPS Rocky Mountain road status →

tioga-road-status.title: Tioga Road Status Today | Chris Izworski
tioga-road-status.description: Check whether Tioga Road is open across Yosemite using current NPS conditions, source language, and a direct official road-status link.
tioga-road-status.h1: Is Tioga Road open across Yosemite today?
tioga-road-status.lede: A fast east-west Yosemite decision: current NPS conditions first, source excerpt second, no seasonal-date guess substituted for the actual road status.
tioga-road-status.decisionTitle: What this tool is trying to answer
tioga-road-status.decisionBody: Tioga Road is a trip-shaping route. When it is closed, east-west itineraries can change by hours. Historical opening dates are interesting, but they are not today’s answer, so this page checks current NPS conditions instead of predicting from the calendar.
bullets: Check current status on the morning of a long crossing.
Do not treat a historical opening date as a current road report.
Construction delays can matter even when the road is technically open.
tioga-road-status.sourceTitle: See the evidence behind the answer
tioga-road-status.sourceBody: The live card reads the NPS Yosemite current-conditions page for Tioga Road status language. If that language is not clear, the result is VERIFY.

cadillac-mountain-sunrise.title: Cadillac Mountain Sunrise Planner | Chris Izworski
cadillac-mountain-sunrise.description: Plan a Cadillac Mountain sunrise with calculated sunrise time, NWS cloud signal, wind, and the Acadia vehicle-reservation rules that affect arrival.
cadillac-mountain-sunrise.h1: Is Cadillac Mountain sunrise worth the early drive?
cadillac-mountain-sunrise.lede: Sunrise time alone is not enough. This combines the solar time with the NWS cloud signal and Acadia’s reservation requirement so you can decide whether to set the alarm.
cadillac-mountain-sunrise.decisionTitle: What this tool is trying to answer
cadillac-mountain-sunrise.decisionBody: A sunrise trip has three gates: the sun has to rise at a known time, the sky has to give you a chance to see it, and you need legal access to the summit road during the reservation season. This tool keeps those decisions together.
bullets: The sunrise time is calculated for Cadillac Mountain, not copied from a generic city forecast.
Cloud wording near sunrise is summarized from the NWS hourly forecast.
During the in-season reservation period, check the official Acadia reservation page before driving up.
cadillac-mountain-sunrise.sourceTitle: See the evidence behind the answer
cadillac-mountain-sunrise.sourceBody: Sunrise is calculated from the mountain coordinates. NWS hourly forecast periods near sunrise provide the cloud/weather signal. NPS controls summit-road reservations.

mount-rainier-road-status.title: Mount Rainier Road Status Today | Chris Izworski
mount-rainier-road-status.description: Check current Mount Rainier road status before choosing Paradise, Sunrise, or another approach. Live NPS source language is shown with the result.
mount-rainier-road-status.h1: Which Mount Rainier roads are open today?
mount-rainier-road-status.lede: Paradise, Sunrise and the park approaches do not always share the same status. Start with the current road system before building the day around a destination.
mount-rainier-road-status.decisionTitle: What this tool is trying to answer
mount-rainier-road-status.decisionBody: Mount Rainier visitors often have a destination in mind before checking whether the approach is actually usable. Fires, snow, construction and seasonal closures can all change the answer. This page elevates the current NPS road source above a generic park-open label.
bullets: Check the approach road for the specific area you want to visit.
Seasonal and emergency closures can affect one side of the park without closing everything.
A VERIFY result means the source did not support a simple park-wide open/closed answer.
mount-rainier-road-status.sourceTitle: See the evidence behind the answer
mount-rainier-road-status.sourceBody: The live card checks the NPS Mount Rainier road-status page and only classifies explicit current open/closed language.
mount-rainier-road-status.sourceLinkLabel: Open NPS Mount Rainier road status →

lake-mead-access.title: Lake Mead Access Today | Chris Izworski
lake-mead-access.description: Translate Lake Mead’s current elevation into an access decision: USBR lake level, NPS launch-ramp guidance, and key low-water thresholds.
lake-mead-access.h1: What can I access at Lake Mead today?
lake-mead-access.lede: The lake level matters because it changes access. This page turns the current elevation into a launch-planning check instead of stopping at a raw number.
lake-mead-access.decisionTitle: What this tool is trying to answer
lake-mead-access.decisionBody: A Lake Mead elevation is only useful if it changes what you do next. Low water can close old concrete ramps, create primitive access, or shift boaters to another harbor. This tool pairs the current Bureau of Reclamation reading with NPS access guidance.
bullets: South Cove’s primitive launch can be used above 1,035 feet, subject to local conditions.
A raw lake elevation is not a ramp-status report; NPS current conditions remain the final access check.
Construction and local ramp conditions can change independently of the lake level.
lake-mead-access.sourceTitle: See the evidence behind the answer
lake-mead-access.sourceBody: The current elevation is parsed from the Bureau of Reclamation’s Lake Mead daily report. NPS launch guidance provides the access context.

lake-powell-ramp-status.title: Lake Powell Boat Ramp Status | Chris Izworski
lake-powell-ramp-status.description: See Lake Powell’s current elevation and the NPS ramp table together: which ramps are open, closed, primitive, or near critical safe-elevation thresholds.
lake-powell-ramp-status.h1: Which Lake Powell boat ramps are usable today?
lake-powell-ramp-status.lede: A water-level number is not the decision. The decision is which ramp works for your boat at that level—so the current NPS ramp table is the center of the tool.
lake-powell-ramp-status.decisionTitle: What this tool is trying to answer
lake-powell-ramp-status.decisionBody: Lake Powell’s shoreline moves enough that launch-ramp usability can change materially with elevation. NPS publishes a current ramp table with availability and minimum safe elevations. This tool brings the level and those ramp decisions into one fast scan.
bullets: Wahweap Stateline Auxiliary is operable at 3,515 feet or above, subject to current NPS status.
Bullfrog North is operable at 3,525 feet or above and has vessel/traffic limitations.
The current NPS status text controls even when a numeric threshold appears favorable.
lake-powell-ramp-status.sourceTitle: See the evidence behind the answer
lake-powell-ramp-status.sourceBody: The live card parses the current NPS Lake Powell elevation and the current published ramp-status and threshold table.
lake-powell-ramp-status.sourceLinkLabel: Open NPS Glen Canyon changing lake levels →
